items.text: The payment of USD 37,090.00 was held due to a sanctions screening hit (0.86 match score) against Desert Star Shipping FZE, but was resolved as a known false positive by Compliance under clearance CLR-2026-0819-07; future payments to this beneficiary require attaching this reference. The most recent occurrence was on 2026-09-25.

DejaVu correctly diagnosed the root cause as CORRESPONDENT_ROUTING_CHANGED with 85% confidence for the 2026-09-18 exception, following previous incorrect diagnoses of CLIENT_TYPO_IN_DETAILS for similar Nordkyst Bank routing issues.
DejaVu correctly diagnosed the payment exception as a known sanctions false positive with 90% confidence.
Victoria Harbour Bank requires an invoice number in the remittance information for all trade payments exceeding USD 10,000.
DejaVu diagnosed the payment rejection as a NAME_LEGAL_SUFFIX_MISMATCH with 85% confidence.
Tungabhadra Co-operative Bank requires exact legal name matches for beneficiaries, specifically rejecting 'Pvt Ltd' in favor of 'PRIVATE LIMITED'.
Payment exception EXC-260915-01 for Kestrel Components Pte Ltd was resolved by adding invoice number KCS-56120 to the remittance information.
DejaVu incorrectly diagnosed the exception as SANCTIONS_POTENTIAL_MATCH; the correct root cause is SANCTIONS_KNOWN_FALSE_POSITIVE.

A payment of USD 55,730.00 from Blue Harbour Logistics Pte Ltd to Desert Star General Trading LLC at Desert Rose Bank (DRBKAEAD) was held on 2026-09-25 due to a 0.86 sanctions match score against Desert Star Shipping FZE.
DejaVu correctly diagnosed the root cause of a payment exception as ACCOUNT_FORMAT_CHANGED with 80% confidence.

Kestrel Components Pte Ltd payment of USD 16,900.00 to Dongguan Precision Parts Co., Ltd. at Pearl Delta Commercial Bank was rejected on 2026-09-24 with reason code AC01 due to the bank's migration to a 15-digit account format; the issue was resolved by prefixing the beneficiary account number 620144880917 with 601.
DejaVu correctly diagnosed the root cause of a payment rejection as MISSING_INVOICE_REFERENCE with 92% confidence.

Payment of USD 11,050.00 from Sunrise Textiles Pte Ltd to Tsuen Wan Garment Accessories Ltd was rejected by Victoria Harbour Bank with reason code RR04 due to a missing invoice reference, then resolved by adding invoice reference 'TWG-7802'.

Payment exception EXC-260923-01 for INR 1,390,000.00 from Vantage Analytics Pte Ltd to Mysuru Software Services Pvt Ltd at Tungabhadra Co-operative Bank was rejected on 2026-09-23 due to a beneficiary name mismatch.

Payment exception EXC-260922-02 occurred on 2026-09-22 for a transfer of INR 1,889,000.00 from Vantage Analytics Pte Ltd to Srinivasa Infotech Private Limited at Golconda Commercial Bank (GOLCINHH), involving Coromandel Clearing Bank as an intermediary.

The payment delay for the Vantage Analytics Pte Ltd transfer (EXC-260922-01) was caused by a MISSED_CUTOFF_NEXT_DAY_CREDIT at Golconda Commercial Bank; DejaVu correctly diagnosed this with 85% confidence.
Payment exception EXC-260922-01 was opened on 2026-09-22 following a non-receipt claim by Srinivasa Infotech Private Limited regarding the 2026-09-21 transfer.
Vantage Analytics Pte Ltd initiated a payment of INR 1,959,000.00 to Srinivasa Infotech Private Limited on 2026-09-21, routed through Coromandel Clearing Bank to Golconda Commercial Bank.
DejaVu diagnosed the payment exception for Hanoi Electronics Assembly JSC as BENEFICIARY_ACCOUNT_CLOSED with 92% confidence.
A payment of USD 59,540.00 from Kestrel Components Pte Ltd to Hanoi Electronics Assembly JSC at Saigon Riverside Bank was returned on 2026-09-21 because the beneficiary closed their account.

Payment exception EXC-260921-01 was triggered by reason code AM05 due to duplicate MYR 38,940.00 transfer instructions from Arcadia Foods Pte Ltd to Penang Spice Traders Sdn Bhd at Straits Heritage Bank, caused by the client's ERP system re-sending the file; DejaVu diagnosed this as CLIENT_ERP_DUPLICATE with 92% confidence.

Tanjong Marine Services Pte Ltd attempted to send USD 27,610.00 to Bergen Subsea Services AS at Nordkyst Bank on 2026-09-18, but the payment was rejected with code RC01 because it used the obsolete intermediary Atlantic Clearing Bank instead of the new correspondent, Hudson Federal Bank.
DejaVu diagnosed the root cause of the payment exception as ACCOUNT_FORMAT_CHANGED with 75% confidence.

The beneficiary account number for Guangzhou Harbour Freight Agency Co., Ltd. at Pearl Delta Commercial Bank was updated from 12 to 15 digits by adding a 601 prefix due to a change in the bank's account format.

Payment exception EXC-260917-02 for Blue Harbour Logistics Pte Ltd involving a USD 12,460.00 transfer to Guangzhou Harbour Freight Agency Co., Ltd. at Pearl Delta Commercial Bank was rejected on 2026-09-17 due to an incorrect account number (reason code AC01).
Lotus Hospitality Group Pte Ltd sent IDR 216,000,000.00 to PT Bali Villas Management at Nusantara Sentral Bank for a management fee instalment on 2026-09-17.

A payment of USD 44,940.00 from Blue Harbour Logistics Pte Ltd to Desert Star General Trading LLC at Desert Rose Bank (DRBKAEAD) was held on 2026-09-16 due to a 0.86 sanctions match score against Desert Star Shipping FZE.

The payment delay for the Vantage Analytics Pte Ltd transfer (EXC-260916-01) was caused by an INTERMEDIARY_DELAY at Coromandel Clearing Bank due to a purpose-code query; DejaVu correctly diagnosed this with 70% confidence.

Vantage Analytics Pte Ltd initiated a payment of INR 777,000.00 to Srinivasa Infotech Private Limited on 2026-09-15 for invoice SI-8960, routed through Coromandel Clearing Bank to Golconda Commercial Bank.
Payment exception EXC-260916-01 was opened on 2026-09-16 following a non-receipt claim by Srinivasa Infotech Private Limited regarding the 2026-09-15 transfer.
DejaVu diagnosed the root cause of the payment exception as a potential sanctions match with 55% confidence.
Compliance has requested ownership documents for Orient Star Maritime Co regarding the held payment exception EXC-260915-02.

Payment exception EXC-260915-02 for Kestrel Components Pte Ltd involving a USD 56,080.00 transfer to Orient Star Maritime Co at Saigon Riverside Bank was held due to a sanctions screening match (score 0.91) against Orient Star Marine Ltd.

Payment exception EXC-260915-01 for Kestrel Components Pte Ltd, involving a USD 16,750.00 transfer to Kowloon Circuit Supplies Ltd, was rejected by Victoria Harbour Bank with reason code RR04 due to a missing invoice reference.
DejaVu diagnosed the root cause of payment exception EXC-260914-02 as CLIENT_TYPO_IN_DETAILS with 55% confidence.

Payment exception EXC-260914-02 for Blue Harbour Logistics Pte Ltd involving a GBP 17,090.00 transfer to Felixstowe Freight Ltd at Thames Union Bank was rejected on 2026-09-14 due to an incorrect BIC (THUBGB2X instead of THUBGB2L).
Arcadia Foods Pte Ltd cancelled the duplicate payment instruction for the 2026-09-14 exception and plans to deploy an ERP scheduler fix in October 2026.
The agent DejaVu diagnosed the root cause of the 2026-09-14 payment exception as CLIENT_ERP_DUPLICATE with 86% confidence.

Payment exception EXC-260914-01 for Arcadia Foods Pte Ltd involving a USD 36,570.00 transfer to Mekong Delta Seafood JSC at Saigon Riverside Bank was held on 2026-09-14 due to a duplication error (AM05) caused by duplicate instructions from the client's ERP system.
DejaVu diagnosed payment exception EXC-260911-02 as a missed cut-off with 85% confidence.
